name: San Mirio
source: Prime Minister of the Celestial Realm.  He is on of the greatest leaders and warriors of the Celestial Race to have participated in the Great War and survived.  Except when it comes to Note's mother, he is strictly rational and logical in his judgments, and he is utterly trustworthy in his current position.
